description.narrative: AGROMINAS contributes directly to the strategic objectives of IFAD¿s Country Strategic Opportunities Program (COSOP) for Brazil 2024¿2029: (i) improving sustainable agricultural production, food security, and nutrition through better access to healthy diets and markets, with an emphasis on environmental and climate sustainability; (ii) improve public policies and programs through evidence-based approaches and scaling up best practices, supporting the development of innovative credit models with the potential to influence policy instruments; and (iii) strengthen the capacity of government institutions and rural community organizations to promote inclusive and sustainable rural development, involving farmers` cooperatives and improving access to credit for small-scale producers and micro and small rural businesses, with a focus on women and youth. AGROMINAS strategically expands IFAD¿s engagement in Brazil by diversifying its operations towards production systems that generate environmental and climate benefits, including biodiversity conservation and the resilience to climate change and desertification.
